units: annual calendar-year decimal returns (0.05 = 5%). assets: nominal USD total return. macro.us_inflation / jp_inflation: Dec/Dec CPI change. macro.usdjpy_change: JPY-per-USD Dec/Dec change (positive = yen weaker).
